_comment: THE edition catalogue. It used to be two hand-written lists — Swift's
that had to match with nothing enforcing it. This file replaces both: the
generator copies these rows into dist/manifest.json, which ships with the
data, and both apps parse it. Adding an edition is a row here plus a tree
under tafsir/<slug>/, never a Swift or Kotlin edit.
A row here MUST have a tree on disk: the generator fails closed rather than
ship a catalogue entry with no data. A tree on disk with no row here is not
bundled, and the generator says so out loud.
'language' is a code. The display string and the flag stay per-platform.
'id' is stable and load-bearing — it is what a user's saved preference
points at. FREE_ID = 169 lives in app code: that is monetization, not data.
'attribution_required' true with an empty 'attribution' is a build failure,
and the reader refuses to open such a bundle at all.
The German row is pending: Rassoul was dropped, Mourad (Erläuterung des
Koran, DIdI) is being extracted into tafsir/de-mourad/. It is added here in
the same commit as its tree, with awaiting_scholarly_review true (ADR-013
gate) and whatever attribution its rights terms require.

editions.name: Ibn Kathir

editions._slug_note: misspelling is load-bearing — the corrected spelling 403s on the CDN and the slug is pinned by a test on both platforms. Do not fix.
